newsitem.title: USA: US mortgage-backed discount/current coupons weaken.
newsitem.headline: US mortgage-backed discount/current coupons weaken.

text.p: Weakness in the Treasury market triggered scattered selling of discount and current coupon U.S. mortgage pass-through securities on Monday, traders said.
"People were moving up in coupon on the belief that this was a consolidation in the Treasury market and that (Treasury) prices may soon be moving higher," said one trader.
He added, "If you believe that we're moving to a better Treasury level, cuspy coupons are likely to give up about five basis points (of spread) this week."
